data.name: Babuna
data.gender_notes: Babuna is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Babuna is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Babhu' meaning father and 'Nadi' meaning water or river. This name is often given to children born near a body of water or to those who are believed to bring good luck and abundance to their families. The name Babuna carries the meaning “Father of Waters” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Babuna usually hope their child will grow to embody father of waters and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Babuna is a name that represents the divine father figure in Hinduism. It is believed to bring strength, wisdom, and prosperity to those who bear this name.
data.etymology: Babuna belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Father of Waters.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Babuna total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.spiritual_significance: The name Babuna holds spiritual significance in Hindu culture as it is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Babhu' meaning father and 'Nadi' meaning water or river. The name represents not only the physical presence of water, but also the spiritual nourishment it provides. The name Babuna is believed to connect the child to the spiritual power and care of their ancestors, just as water nourishes and sustains life. Additionally, the name is associated with the Hindu goddess Ganga Mata, who is believed to purify and cleanse the soul through her water. The name Babuna is a reminder of the interconnectedness of all things in the universe and the importance of honoring and respecting the gift of water and the blessings of one's ancestors.
